items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewee confirms hearing the story about Bud Powell playing with the Birth of the Cool Band, but does not claim personal interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn’t think it was a whole week.

Sy was there. He would’ve been about twenty years old at the time. Sy was there with a friend of his and he told me, apparently, that the Birth of the Cool Band that night had Bud Powell on piano. Do you remember this?
